text:
rachel: Quick heads-up from onboarding: samplekit FNCall + jsonMode hit a weirdness when an auth refresh causes a retry. Tool returned a JSON-string and the client ended up with an extra quoted layer. PoC teams keep tripping over it.

hiro: ugh. we've seen the double-serialize pattern before. do you have a minimal trace?

rachel: sanitized trace:
CLIENT->runtime: fncall foo args={id:1} auth=expired
RUNTIME->tool: returns "{\"name\":\"x\"}" (string)
auth refresh -> retry
RUNTIME->client: "\"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"x\\\"}\"
client receives quoted string, app schema validators fail expecting object

samir: parity gap again between SDKs. node had an optimistic try-parse; python returned raw string. We need a consistent contract.

courtney: proposed fix set:
- introduce normalizeStructuredOutput(value, {jsonMode, contentType, strictJsonMode}) in SDK cores (node/py/go). The helper must be idempotent: normalize(normalize(x)) === normalize(x).
- make retry middleware idempotent and ensure logging helpers never mutate the object sent to the client (logging must deep-clone or stringify a copy).
- add unit tests for idempotence + an e2e in samplekit CI that simulates token expiry mid-call and tools that return JSON-as-strings.

hiro: also add a short "Known FNCall edgecases" note to samplekit README describing the workaround and link the issue. Many customers hit this during first-day PoCs.

rachel: what about UX surface? If a team prefers strict schema enforcement, can we add a config toggle?

courtney: yes, add sdkConfig.strictJsonMode: when true the SDK will surface a clear error when a field's type doesn't match the schema instead of silently coercing. Default false to preserve backwards-compat for old samplekits. Document the tradeoffs in onboarding docs.

samir: logging + observability action: when this bug triggers we should emit a short metric (fncall.retry.double_serialize) so we can measure impact and the samplekit CI can fail on a regression.

devbot: Created INF-5620: "normalizeStructuredOutput + retry idempotency: fix double-serialize for FNCall/ToolCall JSON-strings" assigned to @courtney. Priority: P2. https://tracker.redwood/infr/INF-5620

rachel: for immediate mitigation I'm adding a tiny helper in sampleapp README: `safeParseIfString(v) { if (typeof v==='string') try { return JSON.parse(v) } catch { return v } return v }`. Not ideal but unblocks PoCs.

hiro: timeline? this is onboarding-impacting so prefer small hotfix releases for samplekits and a minor SDK patch across languages.

courtney: agreed. I'll draft PRs for node + python today with normalizeStructuredOutput and a guarded change in retry wrapper. Will coordinate with release team for hotfix samplekit tag.

samir: don't forget tests and a small changelog blurb for onboarding docs.

rachel: thanks everyone. leaving repro + logs in INF-5620. Ping me if you want the failing sample test.
